Andrea (Sales): Quick handoff for KoruLogic — closed $120k ARR. Private deployment (VPC) requested, SSO + SCIM, and an on-prem connector for data ingress. Target go-live 2026-05-10. Main risk: customer timeline vs. SSO/network approvals on their side. Sharing contact + initial asks below.

Mike C (CS): Thanks — assigned to CS intake. Can you drop the primary contact + any compliance docs? I'll spin up the onboarding board and owners.

Andrea (Sales): Primary contact: Priya Rao (priya@korulogic.com), Dir. of AI Ops. They have an internal security review scheduled 04/18. Compliance: SOC2 type II in attachments (link: https://korulogic.example/soc2).

Mike C (CS): Got it. Owners (initial):
- Provisioning & seats: me (Mike C)
- SSO/SCIM integration: @Julia (Eng)
- Private deploy / infra network: @Sam (Support)
- Customer enablement/training: me + Solutions Eng (TBD)
I'll create the onboarding ticket and send calendar invites.

Onboard Bot: New onboarding checklist created -> https://redwood.example/onboard/1717823456 (Checklist autogenerated, items: staging env, SSO test, cert exchange, training session).

Sam (Support): Quick Q: do we have KoruLogic's VPC details / allowed egress IPs? Also need a contact for their infra team so we can share the network runbook.

Andrea (Sales): Priya looped in their infra lead: Marco Diaz <marco@korulogic.com>. I'll intro via email now. VPC CIDR will come after their security review (likely next week).

Julia (Eng): I can lead SSO/SCIM. Flagging integration constraints: our current SSO connector supports SAML and OIDC; SCIM provisioning is available but requires a small webhook: we need their SCIM base URL + an admin API token for provisioning tests. Estimate: 2 dev sprints to finish connector + run tests (ETA ~ 2026-04-25 if started after security review).

Julia (Eng): Short checklist for them to provide to us:
```
- SSO: metadata XML or OIDC discovery URL
- SCIM: base URL + admin token (test account)
- Network: allowed IPs & egress rules for 10.2.0.0/16 (example)
- TLS: cert CN and preferred CAs
```

Mike C (CS): To reduce renewal risk if SSO slips, proposal: start with a hosted eval for core flows while private infra is provisioned. That would get them into Prod-feeling usage earlier. Can we confirm if they'd accept a short-term hosted sandbox? :thinking_face:

Andrea (Sales): Priya said they'd prefer private but open to a hosted sandbox to start. She asked for a two-week pilot first, then full private once network is approved.

Mike C (CS): Great. Proposed next steps (owners + quick ETA):
- Andrea: intro email to infra (done) — owner: Andrea — due: today
- Sam: share network runbook + staging IPs — owner: Sam — due: 04/05
- Julia: start SSO design & request SCIM token — owner: Julia — due: 04/12
- Mike: schedule enablement session & pilot plan (hosted) — owner: Mike — due: 04/15
I'll update the onboarding board and create a Redwood support ticket linking engineering tasks. Ticket: RD-39822 -> https://redwood.example/ticket/RD-39822

Sam (Support): ACK. I'll post the runbook and add steps for firewall config and cert exchange.

Andrea (Sales): Thanks all — I'll watch the ticket and keep Priya updated. Please flag any blockers early. :thumbsup:

Mike C (CS): I'll follow up with a short agenda for the enablement call. If SSO estimate changes, call it out in the ticket so Sales can manage expectations.

Julia (Eng): Noted. If we need a quicker path, we can do OIDC first (faster) and add SCIM after. Calling out as a mitigation option.

Mike C (CS): Closing this thread with actionable owners — will post single-thread summary to the onboarding board and @channel when the ticket is live.
